positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead a 5 member team including myself, which designed, planed & developed WSJ - Context site: context.wsj.com
- Design Solutions for EatClub company: Built a sales automation PoC to enable client sourcing.
- Team seedling to support software development for EatClub's main app.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Plan, Design and development of WSJ - Partners Site: https://partner.wsj.com/
- Lead the efforts to create a common component library used among other internal WSJ apps to unify the new approved design.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Help build the infrastructure to support CI/CD for the internal projects
- Created modules for sales representatives needs
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Django REST Framework and +1 skill

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
- SW Development tasks for a Web based system that collects and reports cpu and network performance of internal computer clusters.
- SW Development of Web application that handles access control to internal infrastructure (computer systems) and related configurations (file system, storage size, preferred shell, etc).
- Defined the process for a particular project to migrate their MySQL database to DB2.
- Conducted Scrum Master activities for other internal projects

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: San Luis Potosí y alrededores, México · On-site
positions.description:
I was part of the team that developed a Logistic and Business Process Management Software for a State Government office. This office handles official state records about public property. 
Among the modules I helped build, my main collaboration was owning E2E the module to process the request for official records and printing, which allowed reducing the response time from weeks to hours.
